nodes.text: Smoke past the hedgerows that isn't ours. I count fires at dusk. Last night there was one too many.

choices.text: Mark it for me. I'll look.

nodes.text: Marked. Go before they dig in. Break it, come home, report.
Wolves take a lamb, that's weather. A camp takes the road, and the road is how bread gets here. Bad enough.
Then send me someone who will.
